title: WPA framework and 2022 amendment
review_notes: Accepted after independent manual audit: exact Act/amendment dates, schedule change, State role and amendment features are readable; no clipping, spelling error, slogan or watermark.

title: Hunting prohibition and vermin notification
review_notes: Accepted after independent manual audit: Section 9 and Section 62 routes remain separate; authority, animal schedule, area and period limits are legible. Full page is text-dense but genuinely explanatory and visually segmented.

title: Four WPA protected-area categories
review_notes: Regenerated both assets after independent audit. Original concept contained an invented sign slogan; original full merged National Park and Wildlife Sanctuary and weakened the four-category explanation. First replacement full was rejected for unsupported NP/WS ownership claims. Final pair is visual-rich, keeps four separate categories and uses only audited land, rights and consultation distinctions.

title: ESZ legal basis and site-specific width
review_notes: Accepted after independent manual audit: EPA basis, site-specific boundary, non-universal 10 km rule and activity classes are clear; no clipping or invented slogan.

title: Tiger, Elephant, Biosphere and Ramsar legal status
review_notes: Accepted after independent manual audit: statutory, administrative, national/international and treaty routes are not conflated; the overlap diagram and Keoladeo example add real explanatory value. Full page is intentionally denser and scores 4 for mobile readability.

title: BHS, OECM and MPA
review_notes: Accepted after independent manual audit: statutory procedure, CBD reporting category and descriptive expression are accurately separated. The full page contains genuine explanation but its longer text blocks limit mobile readability to 4.

title: Tiger Reserve statutory layer and boundary safeguards
review_notes: Accepted after independent manual audit: nested-boundary visual and three independent safeguard flows correctly distinguish National Park/Sanctuary alteration, Tiger Reserve alteration and de-notification; no clipping or added claim.
